label: 📄 CSV / TSV / delimited text
description: Read and write delimited text files. Recognises CSV, TSV, generic .txt, scientific .dat / .data, .tab, .psv. Sniffs the delimiter (comma / tab / semicolon / pipe / single-space) when set to 'auto', and detects whether the first row is a header — when not, columns get sensible names (col_1, col_2, …).

delimiter.label: Delimiter
delimiter.help: 'auto' uses the extension as a hint (.tsv/.tab → tab, .psv → pipe), otherwise sniffs the file (tries , \t ; | and single space, picks the most consistent). Override with a single character; use \t literally for tab.

header.label: Header row
header.help: auto: heuristically detect (data-like row 0 → no header; identifier-like row 0 + numeric rows below → header). yes/no: force the choice. When no header, columns are named col_1, col_2, …
